name: SDN Record Retention Flow
description: Hourly rolling-window retention: the host-cron timer ticks data-source/record-retention expire, which deletes every configured target's records older than now minus window_hours (module config; default 72 h over the weather fields WXF by VALID_TIME_MS) - read with storage.flatsql_query_stream, deleted by content ID with storage.delete. Owner 2026-10-12, the weather node: a rolling 3-day window, configurable, never an archive. The pass's JSON report ends at the flow egress.

triggers.description: Retention pass timer, hourly: the window's edge moves an hour a pass.
